author: FlammableSoloCups
body:
250 Heretic, 51 ALs. Corvus is my favorite subclass for its passive skill critical poise. Makes it a super comfy class to raid with. 

For your offhand, I'd suggest a ruby, and depending on your follower, a couple, or full of blackened kerberos eyes. If you choose not to fill with eyes, and use just a few, or none at all, I'd fill the other slots with ferocious bulls eyes so I can pull some of those ashen pinions off
